title: Dominated convergence of Bochner integrals along a filter
statement:
Use $\mathbf R$ [def-weil-field]. Let $(X,\Sigma,\mu)$ be a measure space, let $E$ be a real Banach space, let $I$ be a set, and let $\mathcal F$ be a filter on $I$ admitting a countable base. Let $F_i:X\to E$ ($i\in I$), $f:X\to E$, and $h:X\to\mathbf R$. Suppose $h$ is Lebesgue integrable, that eventually along $\mathcal F$ the functions $F_i$ are almost everywhere strongly measurable, and that eventually along $\mathcal F$ one has $\|F_i(x)\|\leq h(x)$ for $\mu$-almost every $x$. Suppose also that $F_i(x)\to f(x)$ along $\mathcal F$ for $\mu$-almost every $x$. Then
$$\int_X F_i(x)\,d\mu(x)\longrightarrow\int_X f(x)\,d\mu(x)\quad\text{along }\mathcal F.$$
